Description: Buyer opens the shop or category listing and sees products.
Listing shows a product count and product links.
Product cards show title, price, and image.
Buyer sees a price range filter on the listing.
Buyer filters the listing by brand.
Buyer can limit results to in-stock products.
Buyer can filter listing results by rating.
Buyer can return to the full shop listing after filtering.
Buyer moves through product listing pages.
Buyer opens a product page from a listing card.
Buyer adds a product to cart from the listing page.
Buyer changes Sort items on the listing.
